title: Complete AoA weapon feature contract
policy: Every row is required for every weapon. Concepts, implementation and QA are separate. Not-applicable requires an explicit reason and owner approval; it is never an automatic omission.

features.title: Original identity and exact-version behavior
features.requirements: Registry ID, palette, silhouette, stats, resource, projectile, progression, original in-flight/impact evidence; distinguish extracted assets from captures.

features.title: Canonical concept and visual fidelity
features.requirements: Approved target, orthographic proportions, hero view, paired concept/model views, explicit visual review; alternate designs never silently replace the canonical one.

features.title: Mechanism, grip and hand space
features.requirements: Readable fictional supply-to-emitter path; comfortable grip; Steve/Alex hands where supported; trigger/guard, magazine, feed and moving-part clearances.

features.title: Textures, materials and UVs
features.requirements: Original purposeful pixel/material detail informed by actual reference pack atlases; UV density, seams, padding, shading, wear, emissive masks and LOD texture variants.

features.title: Projectile designs and behavior
features.requirements: Concept art for flight silhouette, count, motion, damage and resource implications; original vs upgraded values; valid entity lifecycle.

features.title: Tracers and trails
features.requirements: Color, shape, width, timing, range, taper, persistence, customization and pooled lifetime; original vs upgraded flight comparison.

features.title: Muzzle flash and firing feedback
features.requirements: Flash, smoke, sparks, local glow, recoil and audio synchronization; distinct emitters and confirmed-shot ownership; no blocked muzzle.

features.title: Impacts and surface responses
features.requirements: Entity, armor, terrain and fluid responses; direct vs area effects; impact art, timing, sounds and damage boundaries.

features.title: Impact decals and world marks
features.requirements: Bullet marks, scorch marks, magical imprints, surface alignment, persistence, pooling and protected-world behavior; no destructive cosmetic block edits.

features.title: Death, kill and finisher effects
features.requirements: Concept storyboard and selectable effects; actual confirmed death trigger, boss/immune cases, multiplayer ownership, cleanup and reduced-effect option.

features.title: Craftables, recipes and progression
features.requirements: Every craftable weapon/component/variant, ingredient images, recipes, source/loot/unlocks, progression balance, optional dependencies and discoverable guide links.

features.title: Functional variants and alternate builds
features.requirements: Concept and implementation for native-preserving default and distinct craftable alternates; clear names, behavior/stat/resource differences, no false equivalence.

features.title: Barrels and energy converters
features.requirements: Identity-specific ballistic, disc, beam, arc, scatter or other meaningful options; visible assembly matches actual projectile/count/cost/cadence.

features.title: Sights, scopes and aiming
features.requirements: Sight choices, reticle art, alignment, aim transition and visibility; Soul Storm anchored flame-to-crosshair transformation; optional candle/gem preserved.

features.title: Handling and muzzle attachments
features.requirements: Grips, stocks, receivers, suppressors, brakes, stabilizers and appropriate equivalents; visible/socket fit, effects, balance and animation interaction.

features.title: Feed, magazines and resource modules
features.requirements: Compatible ammo/energy chambers, visible loading story, optional reloads, native mana/Spirit/resource policies and no silent ammo conversion.

features.title: Effect extraction and recombination
features.requirements: Dismantling, retained effects, donor provenance, transfer rules, stacking/conflicts, previews, balance, costs and save migration.

features.title: Skins and mastercraft variants
features.requirements: Original skins, materials and reactive cosmetic states inspired by reference principles; skin-specific inspect/animation clearance, no unlicensed asset copying.

features.title: Earned functional charms
features.requirements: Charm concepts, attachment sockets, unlock achievements/boss rewards, motion, clipping, declared gameplay modifiers and balance.

features.title: Stickers and emblems
features.requirements: Static, animated, glowing and custom designs; placement zones, layering, UV restrictions, readability, performance and customization persistence.

features.title: Selectable effect channels
features.requirements: Independently configurable projectile, tracer, muzzle, impact, decal and death/finisher looks; compatible combinations and transparent gameplay implications.

features.title: Idle, equip and movement animation
features.requirements: Idle, draw, holster, walk/run/sprint, crouch and other supported movement transitions; first/third person and held/dropped/GUI presentation.

features.title: Fire, charge and recovery animation
features.requirements: Per-emitter fire, charge, recoil, cooling/recovery, resource recovery, dry/blocked input, aim and rapid-repeat behavior.

features.title: Reload or resource-service animation
features.requirements: Tactical/empty reload where appropriate, resource-specific recovery/venting, hand/prop ownership, interruptions and optional-reload behavior.

features.title: Inspect and special choreography
features.requirements: Distinct memorable inspection, mastercraft interactions, state-dependent details, short/reduced-motion option and safe cancellation.

features.title: Audio package
features.requirements: Fire layers, charge/loops, handling, reload/resource service, inspect, flight, impacts, finishers, distance and underwater/environment behavior; provenance.

features.title: UI, tooltips and effective build feedback
features.requirements: Resolved stats, resource costs, attachment/effect compatibility, craftable previews, original vs new values, exact icons and clear limitations.

features.title: Native gameplay, multiplayer and saves
features.requirements: Pinned stack integration, authoritative shots/resources, event deduplication, equip/world/session transitions, saves/migration and rollback.

features.title: Compatibility matrix
features.requirements: Relevant requested mods and exact versions, optional dependency boundaries, creative/survival and server/client checks; untested stays untested.

features.title: Performance and accessibility
features.requirements: Startup/asset costs, frame times and lows, bounded caches/particles/lights, LODs, no repeated scans, reduced motion/flash/shake and readable reticles.

features.title: Documentation and acceptance evidence
features.requirements: Complete weapon page, versioned sources, concept/model/effect comparisons, recipes/unlocks, hashes, reproducible QA, known failures and native footage labels.
